system.description:
This terrible power enables a Setite to break down the mental barriers between the target's Beast and libido. As a result, the victim becomes addicted to sadism and takes pleasure in rage and aggression; the Setite can also reverse the connection so that pleasure rouses the Beast to frenzy, dragging the victim into a spiral of desire and violence and madness.

You must pit your Mental Traits against the target's Humanity (or Path of Enlightenment) Traits to establish the Corruption. The victim receives normal frenzy checks whenever she engages in anything that gives her pleasure, from sex to her favorite food. A character with a Humanity rating greater than 3 automatically loses a point of Humanity for using this power. Corruption cannot be shaken off by spending Willpower; only the Setite who laid it (or perhaps the secret of Golconda) can remove it.
system.source: Clanbook: Followers of Set, Chapter Two
system.duration: Permanent until removed by the Setite who cast it
